# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before making
changes or reviewing code. It is the shared source of project instructions for
the React/TypeScript frontend and Django REST backend.

Check API contracts across both applications, enforce permissions on the server,
validate inputs, keep secrets out of source control and run the relevant checks
listed in `AGENTS.md`. Report missing dependencies or failed checks explicitly.
Do not claim the application follows these rules merely because this file exists.

Maintain project rules in `AGENTS.md` and keep this entry point aligned with it.
